description: Header file defining internal functions, data structures, and constants for device service management in a C-based SDK, including device resource handling, metadata management, power modes, and device communication timestamps.

methods.name: deviceServiceInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the device service, possibly blocking based on parameter.

methods.name: deviceServiceShutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the device service.

methods.name: deviceServiceDeviceFound
methods.description: Handles device discovery event, with option to reject.

methods.name: deviceConfigured
methods.description: Configures a device.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetResourceAgeMillis
methods.description: Gets age in milliseconds since a resource was last updated.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetResourceById
methods.description: Retrieves a device resource by ID, caller must destroy if non-NULL.

methods.name: deviceServiceFindDeviceResourceById
methods.description: Finds a device resource by ID within a device, no destruction needed.

methods.name: updateResource
methods.description: Updates a device resource with new value and metadata.

methods.name: setMetadata
methods.description: Sets metadata for a device endpoint.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata value for a device endpoint.

methods.name: setBooleanMetadata
methods.description: Sets boolean metadata for a device endpoint.

methods.name: getBooleanMetadata
methods.description: Gets boolean metadata for a device endpoint.

methods.name: deviceServiceProcessDeviceDescriptors
methods.description: Processes device descriptors.

methods.name: timeZoneChanged
methods.description: Handles timezone change event.

methods.name: processBlacklistedDevices
methods.description: Processes blacklisted devices based on property value.

methods.name: getMetadataUri
methods.description: Retrieves metadata URI for a device endpoint.

methods.name: deviceServiceGetSecurityExitDelay
methods.description: Reads exit delay from security service.

methods.name: deviceServiceSetOtaUpgradeDelay
methods.description: Sets OTA firmware upgrade delay.

methods.name: deviceServiceAddEndpoint
methods.description: Adds an endpoint to a device and persists it.

methods.name: deviceServiceUpdateEndpoint
methods.description: Re-enables and updates an endpoint for a device.

methods.name: deviceServiceEnterLowPowerMode
methods.description: Instructs subsystem to enter low power mode.

methods.name: deviceServiceExitLowPowerMode
methods.description: Instructs subsystem to exit low power mode.

methods.name: deviceServiceIsInLowPowerMode
methods.description: Checks if system is in low power mode.

methods.name: updateDeviceDateLastContacted
methods.description: Updates last contact timestamp for a device.

methods.name: getDeviceDateLastContacted
methods.description: Retrieves last contact timestamp for a device.

methods.name: getCurrentTimestampString
methods.description: Returns current timestamp as string.
